results.question: Where do I find official parafencing resources?

messages.text:
You can find official parafencing resources from USA Fencing at these links:

Parafencing club finder: https://www.usafencing.org/parafencing-clubs
Introduction to parafencing: https://www.usafencing.org/parafencing-101
Official classification process: https://www.usafencing.org/parafencing-classification
Athlete Handbook and rules: https://www.usafencing.org/rules-compliance

These are project-prepared summaries of public information, not official USA Fencing documents. Always confirm current requirements with the responsible organization. (Source: "Parafencing," https://www.usafencing.org/parafencing, retrieved 2026-09-06)

Would you like help with finding a club, understanding the classification process, or another aspect of parafencing?

results.question: Where should I upload age-verification documents?

messages.text:
For fencing registration, age-verification documents should be uploaded through the official USA Fencing membership portal. Here are the steps:

Go to https://member.usafencing.org and sign in.
Open the user menu and select "Edit Profile."
Under "Personal Information," choose "Age Verification."
Follow the portal's document-upload and verification instructions.

Do not upload documents in this chat. The process and requirements may change, so check the official article for details: "How to complete your Age Verification" at https://usafencing.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/29039352416781-How-to-complete-your-Age-Verification (source date: 2026-04-03, retrieved: 2026-09-06).

Would you like to know what types of documents are accepted or need help with another step?

results.question: Are local and national tournaments registered in the same place?

messages.text:
Local and national fencing tournaments are not registered in the same place:

Local and divisional events: Register on AskFRED at https://www.askfred.net.
Regional and national events: Register through USA Fencing’s membership system at https://member.usafencing.org.

These steps are based on a project-prepared summary of public official-source material, not an official USA Fencing document. For more details or event-specific questions, see the official guide: "How do I register for a USA Fencing Tournament?" at https://usafencing.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/13085696260749-How-do-I-register-for-a-USA-Fencing-Tournament (source date: 2025-05-09).

Would you like tips on finding your first tournament or understanding membership requirements?
